sentences.en: A fart is the tortured scream of a trapped turd.
sentences.zh: 1. 放屁是被困住的大便在受苦时发出的声音。

sentences.en: "Stop torturing me. What did he say?" "He said yes."
sentences.zh: 2. “别再折磨我了。他说什么？”“他说‘是’。”

sentences.en: "Stop torturing me. What did she say?" "She said yes."
sentences.zh: 3. “别再折磨我了。她说什么？”“她说‘是’。”

senses.zh: 折磨，使痛苦；拷问，严刑逼供
